QueryText:
SELECT 
  up.id as up_id,
  up.first_name,
  up.last_name,
  au.sub
FROM user_profile up 
left join app_user au on au.id = up.app_user_id
WHERE up.first_name = 'Macon';
SELECT * FROM user_profile up WHERE up.first_name = 'Macon';

SELECT * FROM fund_transaction WHERE enable = true;
